data.title: Baystate Health Names Dr. Seth Gemme as Chief Physician Executive, Baystate Health and President of Baystate Medical Practices
data.description: After nearly ten years of dedicated service to Baystate, Dr. Gemme is set to take on increased senior leadership duties in Springfield, Massachusetts. On August 7, 2026, Baystate Health revealed that Seth Gemme, MD, has been elevated to the position of Chief Physician Executive within the organization. The promotion signifies a significant milestone in Dr. Gemme's career, reflecting his expertise and contributions to Baystate Health.

data.title: The Inner Circle acknowledges Thomas Ceulemans as an Inner Circle Five Year.

data.title: Breakaway Music Festival and BELLA+CANVAS Expand U.S. Partnership to Elevate Festival Merchandise Through Interactive Fan Experiences
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Los Angeles, it was reported that the Breakaway Music Festival, known as the country's biggest independent touring music festival, has extended its partnership with the prominent blank apparel brand BELLA+CANVAS. This collaboration follows a successful initial partnership in 2025. The upcoming 2026 initiative is set to build upon the prior success and promises an even more expansive venture. The Breakaway Music Festival and BELLA+CANVAS are crucial players in the music and fashion industries, and their reinforced partnership indicates noteworthy developments and mutual benefit. This extended collaboration is anticipated to have a significant impact on the festival scene, with both entities bringing their expertise to the table.

data.title: Cosign Launches in San Jose as Silicon Valley Rental Competition Hits a Decade High
data.description: In San Jose, California, on August 7, 2026, a new platform called Cosign has been introduced. Cosign serves as an alternative to traditional cosigners and third-party lease guarantors. This platform aims to provide renters with increased access to rental opportunities while also ensuring protection for property owners. San Jose, located at the center of Silicon Valley, is facing challenges related to vacant properties, and Cosign offers a solution to this issue.

data.title: Two New Rooftop Restaurant Concepts Bloom at The Sun Rose West Hollywood, Marking the Award-Winning Hotel's Next Iconic Chapter
data.description: Celebrating its one-year milestone, The Sun Rose in West Hollywood has partnered with SAGA Hospitality to revamp its popular rooftop space. The collaboration will bring Yuhi, a 12-seat omakase dining experience offering 17 courses, and Oleander, a restaurant focusing on Coastal Pacific cuisine. The announcement was made in Los Angeles on August 7, 2026, through a press release from PRNewswire. This initiative marks an exciting evolution for the establishment, promising to enhance its dining offerings and overall guest experience.

data.title: Twin Disc Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend 25% to $0.05 Per Share
data.description: In Milwaukee on August 7, 2026, Twin Disc, Inc. revealed its latest financial move as the Board of Directors sanctioned a rise in the regular quarterly cash dividend. The dividend amount has been increased by $0.01 from the previous quarter, marking a significant surge of 25%. This brings the new cash dividend per share to $0.05. Shareholders can anticipate this dividend on September 1, 2026, provided they are recorded as shareholders at the end of business on August 18, 2026.
